name: Umbra Companies Inc.
summary: Umbra Companies Inc. functions as a real estate development investment firm, focusing on creating diverse residential properties. Their projects encompass both individual single-family residences and four-unit multi-family buildings. The company, established in 2016 and based in Century City, California, underwent a name change on July 24, 2019, transitioning from its previous identity as Ocean Electric Inc. It operates as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Panthera Capital Holdings, LLC.
